about: Generated by tools/design_system.py build. Do not edit.

components.name: Icon
components.subtitle: 24 line-art spots in list rows
components.summary: Icon is a small line icon of one piece of water-system equipment, a document or a task, painted with a colour token, that lets a list row be recognised before it is read.

components.name: Illustration
components.subtitle: Equipment line art painted with a token
components.summary: Illustration shows an isometric line drawing of Aquemi equipment, painted with a colour token so the same file works in light and dark themes.

components.name: IsoKit
components.subtitle: Isometric line-drawing kit: every part, a pretreatment-to-point-of-use scene with its water path, and the navy ground
components.summary: IsoKit is the shared isometric line-drawing kit: equipment, pipes, water flow, dimensions, leaders and drawing-sheet furniture in fine 1.5 px technical line art, so every section that draws a system reads as drawn by one hand.

components.name: Page
components.subtitle: Section, container and type classes
components.summary: Page is the layout every Aquemi page, section and preview sits in: the container, the section rhythm and the type classes.

components.name: Placeholder
components.subtitle: Highlighted and clean
components.summary: Placeholder marks a fact only Aquemi can supply (a capacity, lead time, certificate, location, case-study figure) so an invented number never ships.

components.name: SplitSection
components.subtitle: Heading column left, content right
components.summary: SplitSection puts a section's heading in a sticky left column and its content on the right, so long pages alternate between full-width and two-column rhythm instead of stacking heading, text, heading, text.

components.name: Spot
components.subtitle: Equipment vignettes at 96, 128 and 160 px, in ink and ink-muted, on surface and on a plate
components.summary: Spot draws one icon from the Icon set larger, as the figure for a stop on a route, a stage of a process diagram, an option module or a zone of a plant map.

components.name: Button
components.subtitle: Primary, secondary, link and disabled; a call whose number is still a placeholder
components.summary: Buttons start an action or move someone to the next step of an enquiry.

components.name: BackToTop
components.subtitle: Floating button, shown once the reader is well down a page; arrow only on phones
components.summary: BackToTop is a quiet floating button that returns the reader to the top of a long page once they are well down it.

components.name: Footer
components.subtitle: Site footer on navy: Limestone logo, description and contact line, four sitemap columns, legal line
components.summary: Footer closes every page on navy: the Limestone logo with one line of description and the contact line, four sitemap columns, and the legal line.

components.name: NavBar
components.subtitle: Desktop header with the service link; phone menu with the urgent block and section jump
components.summary: The site header: logo, primary sections, a "Service request" link and one call to action.

components.name: SectionNav
components.subtitle: Numbered jump links and page progress on a system page
components.summary: SectionNav is a sticky bar of numbered jump links to the sections of a long technical page, with a quiet page progress readout.

components.name: Band
components.subtitle: Statement band on limestone, and on sunken with an optional mark
components.summary: Band sets one short statement large on a quiet limestone or sunken ground, with a supporting line and a faint pipework line drawing at the right; its ground modifiers (`aq-band--limestone`, `aq-band--sunken`, `aq-band--navy`) also change the ground for other sections.

components.name: BatteryLimit
components.subtitle: Site requirements on a navy and limestone split; the divide is the battery limit, every card tied to it by a leader
components.summary: BatteryLimit lays site requirements on a navy and limestone split whose divide is the battery limit, so the reader sees each requirement as a connection point on the line between the package and their site.

components.name: BudgetBento
components.subtitle: Budget ranges as a Swiss bento: the whole package as the navy lead tile, three modules beside it, what moves the price and what is excluded as chips
components.summary: BudgetBento sets budget ranges as a Swiss bento of numbered tiles, the whole package as a tall navy lead tile and each module beside it, so a range reads as a price sheet with its scope and basis rather than as a table row.

components.name: CaseStudy
components.subtitle: Fact rows and outcome figure; second awaits its figure; third is a template with status, profile and method; fourth is a project record (drawing, outcomes, timeline)
components.summary: CaseStudy summarizes a delivered project as hairline fact rows (client, problem, system delivered) beside one large measured-outcome figure on a quiet panel.

components.name: ClauseCrosswalk
components.subtitle: Requirements wired to two regulations' clauses: editorial crosswalk with vertical spines
components.summary: ClauseCrosswalk sets a table of requirements against two regulations' clauses as an editorial crosswalk: the requirements large down the middle, each regulation a spine at the outer edge with its name set big and vertical and its clauses as chips, and a wire from every requirement to every clause it cites.

components.name: Closing
components.subtitle: Closing band: display headline on navy with the large faint mark cut by the corner, large Limestone button; the exchange drawn as send rows, a pipe with the turnaround and returned sheets
components.summary: Closing is the call to action at the end of every page: one centred display headline on the navy band, one lead sentence and a large primary button, with the brand mark large and faint, cut by the top-left corner.

components.name: ContactRoutes
components.subtitle: Three ways in as rows on hairlines: proposal (this page), urgent service on limestone with its call line, shop visit; each with a 1-2-3 strip and a response clock
components.summary: ContactRoutes sets the ways into Aquemi as rows on hairlines, each with its own numbered 1 → 2 → 3 strip and response clock, so a visitor on a contact page sees which route fits before the form: request a proposal, production stopped (call the service line), or visit the shop.

components.name: CutawayRail
components.subtitle: GMP standards on a rail beside a sticky cutaway; the active card lights the parts it governs
components.summary: CutawayRail reads an evidence table beside one sticky drawing: a close isometric cutaway of the plant stays in view while one card per standard runs down a rail, and the card being read lights the parts it governs, with an "active" tag and a callout naming it.

components.name: DecisionValve
components.subtitle: Chlorine or chloramine: supplies routed through a multiport valve to the removal step
components.summary: DecisionValve draws a router table as a multiport valve on a navy band: supplies on the left, the valve with one numbered position per route in the middle, the routes as cards on the right; choosing a supply turns the lever to that position and lights the line in and the line out, while every card stays readable.

components.name: DocHotspots
components.subtitle: Four documents pinned by hotspots to the parts of the PW skid they cover
components.summary: DocHotspots pins the documents delivered with a system to the parts of the skid they cover, so the reader sees what each record is about on the equipment itself.

components.name: DocList
components.subtitle: Documents as a hairline list: code in mono, name, detail; key documents first, code in flow; one link to the full index
components.summary: DocList shows the documents delivered with a system as a quiet hairline list: each row gives the short code a validation team files the document under, its name and one line of detail, with the deciding documents first and their code in `flow`.

components.name: EvidenceMap
components.subtitle: Requirement, how we meet it, file chips or clause references
components.summary: EvidenceMap maps each requirement or standard to how we meet it and the documents that prove it, drawn as a mapping with leader lines and file-shaped chips, for the validation lead asking "where is the proof?".

components.name: Explainer
components.subtitle: One idea as a token-drawn figure plus numbered callouts: endotoxin margin
components.summary: Explainer sets out one idea as a figure plus three or four short numbered callouts instead of paragraphs, for a mechanism a reader should see at a glance (endotoxin margin set by the feed, what an upgrade costs in requalification).

components.name: ExplodedService
components.subtitle: Home: service promises as callouts on an exploded pump, on a light drawing sheet
components.summary: ExplodedService pins a few service promises to an exploded view of the part that service keeps running: a centrifugal pump drawn apart along its shaft on a light drawing sheet, with a leader from three of its parts to the promises.

components.name: FAQ
components.subtitle: Question rows under the outline counter, five questions all closed
components.summary: FAQ answers the questions engineers and QA ask before they call, as question rows under a large outline counter: index, question and a square +/− key, with the answer opening under the question.

components.name: FaultList
components.subtitle: Failure modes that open to cause and design control
components.summary: FaultList lists where things fail and what we design against; each failure opens to its cause and the design control.

components.name: GradeEditorial
components.subtitle: Your first PW system as an editorial spread: navy mast, pipe collage, grade words set huge
components.summary: GradeEditorial sets a short path (a grid block of about five items) as an editorial spread: the heading oversized on a navy mast, a geometric pipe collage facing asymmetric fact blocks whose key words (a grade, a span, a figure) are set huge.

components.name: GradeLanes
components.subtitle: Minimum water grade by step, on three lanes
components.summary: GradeLanes shows the minimum water grade step by step: each step drops a tap into one of three lanes, Potable, PW and WFI.

components.name: Hero
components.subtitle: Five heroes: home loop drawing, hub index, system equipment drawing, drawn binder and drawn route figures
components.summary: Hero opens every page: eyebrow, one display headline, one lead sentence, one primary button and one link.

components.name: HmiTrend
components.subtitle: Alarm lines as the operator panel's own dark screen: a trend against the limits, the drift flagged, the alarm summary
components.summary: HmiTrend sets a table of alarm lines (line, how it is set, what the system does) as the operator panel's own screen: a dark instrument panel with a trend plot of one reading under the limit lines, flagged by the trend rule before it reaches any of them, and the alarm summary as the real table.

components.name: HoldTimeline
components.subtitle: Services: six stages on a rising line over a macro weld; hold points ringed, PQ as the boxed figure
components.summary: HoldTimeline draws a sequence of stages with hold points as nodes on one rising line across a dark macro close-up of a fused pipe joint, each stage's duration and deliverables hung off its node.

components.name: IndustryFeed
components.subtitle: Home: one water line teeing into three industries, each standard set large as the evidence
components.summary: IndustryFeed sets a few destinations of the same water as editorial type: one twin-wall pipe enters from the page edge and tees down into each column, where the destination's evidence (its standard) is the hero type.

components.name: LayerStack
components.subtitle: A system's layers as an exploded isometric stack of plates, labels on leaders, one packet riding the data route
components.summary: LayerStack shows the layers of one system (field instruments up to the plant network) as an exploded isometric stack of machined plates, each carrying its equipment, with the labels on leaders from the plate corners.

components.name: LimitBento
components.subtitle: Purified Water limits as a bento: one oversized numeral per tile, a navy water column filled to the stricter value
components.summary: LimitBento sets a page's water-quality limits as a bento of tiles, one limit per tile with its value as an oversized Geist Mono numeral, around a tall navy water column that is filled to the stricter limit with the looser pharmacopoeia value marked high above it.

components.name: LimitStack
components.subtitle: Purified Water limits as a stepped type stack beside the outlet pipe and its Guaranteed collar
components.summary: LimitStack sets a page's water-quality limits as an editorial type stack beside a sculpted outlet pipe, so the reader sees each limit large, its reference, and the guaranteed skid-outlet value as the stack's last, boxed step.

components.name: LinkGrid
components.subtitle: Six services as linked rows: index, title, one line, standard tag, drawing
components.summary: LinkGrid sets out a list of choices (services, industries, systems, upgrade types) as rows of the shared list grammar: index, title with an arrow when it links, one line, an optional standard tag, and the linked page's icon at the row end on desktop.

components.name: MacroLeaders
components.subtitle: Grade, limit and inspector by industry, called out from a macro drawing of membrane leaves and a PP weld
components.summary: MacroLeaders sets a comparison table beside a macro drawing (RO membrane leaves fanned over a PP pipe and its weld bead) and calls each row out from it with a numbered marker and a leader, so a by-industry table reads as one piece of equipment serving every row.

components.name: ManifoldRouter
components.subtitle: Home: seven situations as branches off one manifold, the open route on a raised sheet
components.summary: ManifoldRouter sets a router table as large type on a limestone sheet, every situation a branch off one manifold: the reader picks a situation, the water runs down to its branch and its route opens beside it.

components.name: MarketCallouts
components.subtitle: Adjacent uses as callouts around one PW package drawn as a solid object on navy
components.summary: MarketCallouts shows several markets served by one machine: a single PW package drawn with IsoKit stands centred on a navy ground as a solid limestone object, and each option is a callout around it with a leader to the part its note is about.

components.name: MembraneAtlas
components.subtitle: Feed water conditions as micrograph plates of what each does to the membrane
components.summary: MembraneAtlas reads a feed-water table as an atlas of membrane failures: one plate per condition, a round micrograph of the membrane surface showing what that condition does to it, then the condition, its effect and what we design for.

components.name: MembraneFace
components.subtitle: RO feed targets as a bento round the feed end of a spiral-wound RO element
components.summary: MembraneFace sets a short list of feed-water targets as a bento round the thing they protect: the feed end of a spiral-wound reverse osmosis element, drawn large on navy, with one target per tile around it.

components.name: NotesRegister
components.subtitle: Planned notes as a revision register, filtered by topic
components.summary: NotesRegister lists technical notes as a register table: date, note number, topic, title and standard, with topic filter chips and the latest or next planned note in a quiet panel beside it.

components.name: OptionList
components.subtitle: Options as hairline rows; decisions with a ? and a fork mark, one linked to the page that holds it
components.summary: OptionList shows the configuration choices for a system as rows of the shared list grammar: index, option name and one line on what it does.

components.name: OptionModules
components.subtitle: System options as modules wired to the base skid drawing
components.summary: OptionModules draws a system's equipment options as modules around the page's own equipment drawing (the base skid), each wired to it by a dashed hairline; it is the `as: "modules"` shape of the options block (OptionList).

components.name: OptionTags
components.subtitle: Five PW skid options as shipping tags, a round tag and folders on a limestone table
components.summary: OptionTags lays a system's configuration options out as physical tags on a limestone table, so each option reads as a separate item the buyer can add to the base skid.

components.name: OptionTaps
components.subtitle: Pretreatment options as dashed parts teed off the standard train
components.summary: OptionTaps shows options where they would join the system: the standard train drawn solid in isometric line on a blueprint sheet, and each option as a dashed part (the drawing convention for "optional") on its own dashed tee off the main line, with numbered cards under the sheet.

components.name: ParamTiles
components.subtitle: Ten skid design parameters as numbered Swiss tiles with a blueprint cell
components.summary: ParamTiles sets a system's design parameters as a Swiss grid of numbered tiles with one blueprint cell of the skid, so each parameter reads as its own panel and the whole grid scans at a glance.

components.name: ParameterCallouts
components.subtitle: Skid design parameters called out on the equipment drawing, the rest folded below
components.summary: ParameterCallouts lays a system's design parameters on its own equipment drawing, with leader lines from numbered labels to the part each one is about.

components.name: PidRoutes
components.subtitle: Router table drawn as a P&ID on navy: five situations piped through valves to a system and a start
components.summary: PidRoutes draws a router table (situation, system, start with) as a P&ID on a navy blueprint ground: each situation is piped through its own valve to its system and on to where to start, and rows that share a destination page are tied by a header line.

components.name: PipeCollage
components.subtitle: Engineering standards as a Swiss poster: a geometric collage, one numbered piece per standard, editorial blocks on brackets
components.summary: PipeCollage sets an evidence table as a Swiss poster: a geometric collage of flat pieces, one numbered piece per standard (a pressure vessel, a control panel, a flanged elbow, resin pellets, a fused joint) among plain filler tiles, beside the rows as asymmetric editorial blocks hung from hairline brackets.

components.name: ProcessDiagram
components.subtitle: PW skid treatment train as an line-art piping flow: stations are toggles, the pipe tints up to the selected one and its detail opens
components.summary: ProcessDiagram draws a treatment train as an interactive piping flow in single-weight line art: each stage is a station with its equipment vignette, joined by one double-hairline `flow` pipe with arrows, and choosing a station tints the pipe up to it and opens that stage's detail.

components.name: ProcessSteps
components.subtitle: Steps as numbered rows (a row may link to the page that holds that step), or a line-art hold flow
components.summary: ProcessSteps shows a real sequence (a project, a qualification, a service visit) as rows of the shared list grammar: index, step name and what happens.

components.name: ProjectRun
components.subtitle: Home: five project steps down one run, each with its equipment drawing (live: sticky stage, water fills with scroll)
components.summary: ProjectRun tells ordered steps as one run the reader scrolls along: on wide screens a sticky stage shows the current step's equipment drawing, its number set huge and a pipe whose water fills stop by stop as the steps scroll past.

components.name: ProofFolders
components.subtitle: Pharmacopoeias as a drawer of manila folders: typed slip, clipped proof sheets struck with a stamp, navy index label
components.summary: ProofFolders shows an evidence table as a drawer of manila folders, one per standard: the standard set large beside its folder, what we design to typed on a slip, the proof as clipped sheets struck with a stamp of the standard's code, and where we show it as the folder's navy index label.

components.name: Prose
components.subtitle: Heading left; a large light lead, then the paragraphs
components.summary: Prose is running text in a SplitSection: the heading on the left, the first sentence as a large light lead, then the paragraphs in body size, with white space and nothing else around them.

components.name: RailModules
components.subtitle: Options as modules clipped on a DIN rail, in macro close-up, each line on a leader under the plate
components.summary: RailModules shows an options block as a macro close-up of a control panel backplate: one DIN rail across the plate and off both page edges, every option a module clipped onto it (terminal screws, status lamp, number, engraved icon, name), its line hanging on a leader under the plate.

components.name: Readout
components.subtitle: One limit as the page's highlighted figure: the WFI endotoxin limit from the home page
components.summary: Readout sets the page's one highlighted figure: the number large in Geist Mono Light in `flow` with its unit, the method on a limit tag, and a short caption.

components.name: RelatedLinks
components.subtitle: Four next pages as tiles hung off one pipe: drawings for system pages
components.summary: RelatedLinks closes a page with the pages to read next as tiles hung off one pipe: each tile shows its index and section, a picture of the target page and its title with a `flow` arrow.

components.name: RoleMatrix
components.subtitle: Who writes and who reviews, as signature stamps
components.summary: RoleMatrix shows who writes, does and approves each document, like the signature blocks on a controlled document, so the split between our work and your sign-off is visible at a glance.

components.name: Router
components.subtitle: Pick your situation, see one route; pending stations dashed
components.summary: Router lets a buyer pick the situation they are in and see one route through what follows: the water they need, the system, and where to start with us.

components.name: SectionTrain
components.subtitle: The pretreatment train as one sectional elevation, each bed holding what it caught
components.summary: SectionTrain draws a pretreatment train as one sectional elevation on a limestone sheet, every vessel cut open so its bed shows and each bed holding what it caught, so the reader sees the water lose its particles, hardness, chlorine and fines stage by stage.

components.name: SensorLoop
components.subtitle: Signals drawn where they are measured: an instrumented loop with ISA balloons, schedule cards on leaders, the signal bus
components.summary: SensorLoop draws a spec block of signals where each one is measured: one instrumented storage and distribution loop in IsoKit line art with an ISA instrument balloon on every measuring point, instrument schedule cards above and below on leaders, and a dashed signal bus every instrument drops into.

components.name: SheetPreviews
components.subtitle: Pretreatment documents as a Swiss row of sheets, each thumbnail showing its kind
components.summary: SheetPreviews sets a short document list as a Swiss row of sheets: a huge index numeral, a paper sheet whose thumbnail shows what kind of document it is, then its code, name and line.

components.name: StairRouter
components.subtitle: Services: seven situations as a rising stair of cards over outline type, Go on the limestone wedge
components.summary: StairRouter draws a router table ("which situation are you in, where do you start") as a rising staircase of situation cards over huge cropped outline type, every route open at once.

components.name: StandardWires
components.subtitle: Standards on a navy blueprint, each answer wired to the equipment that answers it
components.summary: StandardWires sets a table of standards on a navy blueprint and wires each answer to the equipment that answers it, so a reader who starts from a standard sees which part of the system meets it.

components.name: StandardsGrid
components.subtitle: The twelve standards on the home page, code only, on hairlines
components.summary: StandardsGrid lists the standards Aquemi designs to as a numbered three-column grid on `line` hairlines, as a section of its own under a large headline.

components.name: StandardsMap
components.subtitle: Zones of the water system on one pipe, each labelled with the standards that govern it
components.summary: StandardsMap is a plant map of the water system: each zone (generation, storage and distribution, pure steam, controls and data, fabrication, qualification) is a hairline-framed area labelled with the standards that govern it, and every code jumps to the row further down the page that proves it.

components.name: StandardsOrbit
components.subtitle: Standards as nodes on orbit rings round the PW plant; each zone arcs in to the part it governs, its codes jump to their proof
components.summary: StandardsOrbit draws a standards map as orbits round the plant: the Purified Water plant in isometric line art in the middle of a navy band, two elliptical rings round it, and each zone of the system a node on the outer ring with its standards beside it and an arc running in to the part that zone governs.

components.name: StrataRun
components.subtitle: One water run down a terrace of paper slabs: six stages from feed water to points of use, each label leading to its equipment
components.summary: StrataRun draws a process diagram as one water run stepping down a terrace of stacked paper slabs, so the reader sees the whole package from feed water to points of use as a single route through real equipment.

components.name: SystemRun
components.subtitle: Home: the package as one water line through pretreatment, PW generation, storage and monitoring, a navy blueprint
components.summary: SystemRun shows a modular package as one continuous water line drawn as a navy blueprint: drinking water enters at the left, runs through each system's equipment in order and leaves at the point of use, with a column per system under the drawing.

components.name: Versus
components.subtitle: Two routes across a spine of factors, with a verdict or a conclusion band
components.summary: Versus sets two routes face to face across a spine of factors, for a buyer choosing one of two (hot or ambient WFI, multi-effect or vapour compression).

components.name: VisitRoute
components.subtitle: A preventive maintenance visit as numbered stops on one route, ending in sign-off
components.summary: VisitRoute lays a visit's checks out as numbered stops on one route line drawn on a Plate, each stop a line drawing of the equipment it covers, for a walk-round whose order matters, such as what a preventive maintenance visit covers, ending at the sign-off.

components.name: WaterPath
components.subtitle: Seven system families as stations on one pipe; the selected family opens its line, standard and link
components.summary: WaterPath shows the system families as stations on one pipe, from city feed to point of use, so the reader sees how the systems connect and can open each one's line, standard and page from the drawing.

components.name: WindingRoute
components.subtitle: Seven treatment stages as stops on one winding pipe across a navy band
components.summary: WindingRoute draws a treatment train as one winding pipe across a navy band, each stage a stop on the wave with its line glyph, so the reader follows the water stage by stage.

components.name: CompareTable
components.subtitle: Start from your water grade: four grades against standard and limits, with a link column
components.summary: CompareTable sets three or more options against criteria as a hairline matrix, with sentence-case column heads on `surface-sunken`, numbered row labels in a narrow left column and, on phones, one record per row (or column tabs for wide tables) instead of a sideways scroll.

components.name: KeyFacts
components.subtitle: Aquemi's own figures, each with its unit and basis, as a quiet strip between hairlines (home, sys-storage and contact-service, placeholders until confirmed)
components.summary: KeyFacts is a strip of up to four of Aquemi's own figures, each with its unit and the basis a reader can hold us to, that tells an engineer what a page stands on before they read a word of copy.

components.name: LimitGauges
components.subtitle: Release limits as dials; design rules as threshold bars, a row linking where it is set; two limits two across, the action level named as one
components.summary: LimitGauges shows a block of water or steam quality limits as quiet instrument faces on a plate, one dial per limit, so a reader sees at a glance where each limit sits and which side of it passes.

components.name: PlanTiers
components.subtitle: Service plans side by side: who each suits, price, terms, one action per plan
components.summary: PlanTiers compares service plans in one table on a plate: numbered terms down the left, one column per plan, a "Fits when" row and one action per plan, for a buyer choosing a plan tier.

components.name: SpecTable
components.subtitle: WFI spec sheet with the critical limit as a readout band, and a comparison table
components.summary: Specification sheets present water quality limits as a two-column matrix with the one critical limit pulled out as a full-width band, the most persuasive content Aquemi has.

components.name: StandardTag
components.subtitle: Standards a system is designed to
components.summary: Standard tags name the regulation, pharmacopoeia or engineering code a system is built to.

components.name: EnquiryForm
components.subtitle: A numbered data sheet with its note under the submit; the stepped form's first step, with a note that sends supplier audits to their own form; an application step with a placeholder option chosen and a required upload left empty
components.summary: EnquiryForm lays out a proposal, service or application request as a numbered data sheet on a quiet panel: numbered sections, numbered items and one submit.

components.name: TextField
components.subtitle: Default, with unit, and error
components.summary: Text fields collect enquiry and service-request details.
